question: Which thresholds are checked for the annotation FS?
Which procedure uses the threshold SOR_gt_3, and how many thresholds does it use in total?
cypher: MATCH (p:Procedure)-[:HAS_THRESHOLD]->(:Threshold {id:'SOR_gt_3'}) MATCH (p)-[:HAS_THRESHOLD]->(t) WITH p, count(t) AS n RETURN p.id UNION MATCH (p:Procedure)-[:HAS_THRESHOLD]->(:Threshold {id:'SOR_gt_3'}) MATCH (p)-[:HAS_THRESHOLD]->(t) RETURN toString(count(t))

question: Which genes belong to the HBOC panel?
Which file was sample1.vcf derived from, and which instrument generated it?
cypher: MATCH (v:DataFile {id:'sample1_vcf'})-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(b) RETURN b.id UNION MATCH (v:DataFile {id:'sample1_vcf'})-[:GENERATED_BY]->(i) RETURN i.id

question: In which gene is variant VAR-001 located, and which panel includes that gene?
cypher: MATCH (:Variant {id:'VAR-001'})-[:LOCATED_IN]->(g) RETURN g.symbol UNION MATCH (:Variant {id:'VAR-001'})-[:LOCATED_IN]->(g)<-[:HAS_MEMBER]-(p) RETURN p.name

question: If sample1.bam is replaced, which downstream data files and procedures are affected?
cypher: MATCH (d:DataFile)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..3]->(:DataFile {id:'sample1_bam'}) RETURN d.id UNION MATCH (p:Procedure)-[:APPLIES_TO]->(d:DataFile)-[:DERIVED_FROM*1..3]->(:DataFile {id:'sample1_bam'}) RETURN p.id

question: Who are the parents and the sibling of Olena?
Which variant does Olena carry, and in which gene is it located?
cypher: MATCH (:Person {name:'Olena'})-[:CARRIES]->(v)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(g) RETURN v.id UNION MATCH (:Person {name:'Olena'})-[:CARRIES]->(v)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(g) RETURN g.symbol

question: What diagnosis does Iryna have, and which relationship class does she belong to relative to the proband, with what inheritance probability?
cypher: MATCH (:Person {name:'Iryna'})-[:HAS_DIAGNOSIS]->(d) RETURN d.kind UNION MATCH (:Person {name:'Iryna'})-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(c) RETURN c.name UNION MATCH (:Person {name:'Iryna'})-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(c) RETURN toString(c.probability)

question: Which procedure requires variant VAR-001, and what is its minimum testing age?
cypher: MATCH (p:Procedure)-[:REQUIRES]->(:Variant {id:'VAR-001'}) RETURN p.id UNION MATCH (p:Procedure)-[:REQUIRES]->(:Variant {id:'VAR-001'}) RETURN toString(p.minTestingAge)
